'''Stone-bladed spears''' were used by [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] warriors around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. They were also known to use [[metal war axe]]s, [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] and [[tarpoon]]s.
